mentions.name: marksan
mentions.description: A CLI tool that sanitizes browser bookmarks: it takes an HTML file exported from Firefox and rewrites each anchor tag to keep only the HREF, stripping metadata such as ADD_DATE, LAST_MODIFIED, ICON_URI and the long ICON strings, which the author treats as suspected tracking code, then produces a clean bookmarks file.
mentions.problem: Exported Firefox bookmark HTML contains long, suspicious ICON strings and other unnecessary attributes (ADD_DATE, LAST_MODIFIED, ICON_URI) that look like tracking code, when only the HREF is needed for a bookmark to function.
mentions.audience: Personal use (a tool for the author's own use)
mentions.source_excerpt: A CLI to replace bookmarks in my browser because I noticed some tracking code lurking in my Firefox bookmarks.  This is just personal tool for my own use.

evidence.value: A CLI to replace bookmarks in my browser because I noticed some tracking code lurking in my Firefox bookmarks.  This is just personal tool for my own use.
